items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I was on the road with Ida about... About twelve years ago I was on the road with Ida.

ctx.x: See, we covered all six of them now? Something up in there? Della. Let's see.
Della? Della. Della, she played as my next older sister, see. Mabel was the oldest, then Della, then came Sadie, then Edna, then myself, then Ida.
Well, who did Della play with?
